verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document dedicated error-handling branches, error workflows, or failure notifications for flow runs. The only reliability-related item covers durable execution, where interrupted runs resume from a checkpoint. That is an adjacent recovery feature, not an error path or a failure alert, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
